measure: Fuel subsidies for affected industries raised to the EU maximum, until 31 December
why: Expires in weeks; does nothing about the price shock itself.

measure: G7 release of 100 million barrels of oil and diesel over four months
why: A one-off release; stocks must be rebuilt later.

measure: 10 million barrels of diesel released from French strategic reserves
why: Lowered prices at about 6 in 10 stations; one-off.

measure: First-year lycée classes capped at 28 pupils, starting in disadvantaged schools from 2027
why: Structural, but covers one year group and starts in some schools only.

measure: Planned cuts to secondary teaching posts cancelled, plus 500 new posts
why: Stops a cut; 500 posts is small against thousands of schools.

measure: Up to €4 billion in low-interest loans to regions for school renovation, until 2030
why: Multi-year, but loans add to regional debt rather than new state money.

measure: Parcoursup admissions platform reformed for 2027 and replaced in 2028
why: A real structural change, delivered after the 2027 election.

measure: Student grants to rise with inflation from the 2027 academic year
why: Protects grants from inflation but does not raise them.

measure: Minimum wage up 1.6% from 1 December (about €24 net a month)
why: Mostly the automatic January rise brought forward one month, plus 0.6 points.

measure: Tax-free overtime ceiling raised to €10,000; value-sharing bonus extended; 75% cover of transport passes kept for 2027
why: Helps people already in work who do overtime; no general pay rise.

measure: 69 sectors with pay scales below the minimum wage told to renegotiate; employer contribution relief tied to compliance
why: Could lift low pay scales lastingly if the decree is enforced.

measure: Public-sector pay talks postponed to 11 December
why: Unions called it stalling; the CFDT joined the 17 November strike in response.

measure: Up to 70,000 police deployed per protest day; fast-track trials; bill making protesters liable for damage
why: Contains unrest without addressing its causes.

measure: 2027 budget: €43 billion of savings to cut the deficit to 5.0% of GDP
why: The only long-run plan, rejected 458 to 0 in the Assembly on 4 November.

measure: 2023 pension reform (retirement at 64) suspended; pensions above €1,260 a month to rise by less than inflation
why: Postpones the decision past the 2027 election; reversing the reform would cost about €10 billion a year.
